notes: Trazer is used when the destination of the object is where the speaker currently is or will be. Use 'levar' when you are taking something to a place away from where you are.
In informal Brazilian Portuguese, it is very common to hear 'trazer' conjugated as 'trás' in the third person singular, though 'traz' is the standard written form.
